name: frankie-tarot
description: Draw and explore a bilingual tarot deck with an interactive card table and reflective conversation.

interface.longDescription:
F.Tarot is an interactive tarot table for taking a moment to reflect on a question, a creative block, or a choice.

Choose from 11 spreads, pick and turn over your cards, and explore a 78-card deck with English and Simplified Chinese meanings. Switch between original, redrawn, and dreamy artwork as you explore the cards.

When you're ready, invite ChatGPT to interpret your spread. A brief reading appears in the card table; use Ask Deeper to continue the conversation with the same cards. Save Result exports a PNG of your cards, question, and reading.

Designed for personal reflection and exploring possibilities.
defaultPrompt: Open F.Tarot. I'd like to explore how to keep a steady creative rhythm.
Open F.Tarot so I can choose a spread, pick my cards, and turn them over myself.
Open F.Tarot. I want to reflect on what deserves my attention this week.

review.commerce_description: F.Tarot does not sell products or services or process payments.

positive.description: P1 — Chinese spread discovery. Start a fresh chat with F.Tarot selected and no active draw. Ask for available spreads without drawing. Verify localized names and card counts against the returned catalog; do not require any particular random cards.
positive.prompt: 有哪些塔罗牌阵可选？请用中文介绍，不要抽牌。
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_tarot_spreads with locale=zh-CN. Return the 11 supported spreads with names and card counts from the response. Do not call draw_tarot_cards, reveal_tarot_cards or show_tarot_result, or fabricate a reading.

positive.description: P2 — A conversational question opens setup. Start a fresh chat. The user must still choose the spread and start the ritual in the original interactive app.
positive.prompt: 打开 F.Tarot，我想探索如何保持创作节奏。让我自己选择牌阵和选牌，先不要解读。
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_tarot with the question and locale=zh-CN; omit flowId only on the first launch. The returned stage is input, the question is prefilled, cards is empty and canInterpret=false. Open the original table inline. Do not draw, flip, or interpret from this question alone.

positive.description: P3 — Complete an English three-card reading. In the app select THREE, start the ritual, pick three cards and turn over all three. Observe that the assistant waits, then click Interpret with ChatGPT. Use only the current session's structured data.
positive.prompt: Open F.Tarot in English with a three-card spread for: What could help my creative work this week? Let me pick and reveal the cards, then wait for me to request an interpretation.
positive.expected_behavior: Open setup with spread=THREE and locale=en. The app's start and flip actions call draw_tarot_cards and reveal_tarot_cards while preserving flowId; hidden cards are absent from model-visible cards. After all three flips and the explicit interpretation click, call show_tarot_result with intent=interpret and the newest sessionToken. Use the exact returned cards, positions and orientations, with a brief cohesive English reading in the original table. Deeper analysis stays in ordinary chat. Do not redraw or open a separate result page. Verify actual card images load.

positive.description: P4 — Partial reveal and restoration. Setup: start a Chinese THREE draw in the app, pick three cards and leave them face down. Use its current structured session. After the first prompt, ask to reopen the same table without a new draw.
positive.prompt: 只翻开第二张牌，其他两张保持背面，先不要解读。
positive.expected_behavior: Call reveal_tarot_cards with positions=[2] and the newest sessionToken. Exactly that position becomes revealed; hidden card identities and complete-spread prompts remain absent from model-visible content and canInterpret=false. On the follow-up request to reopen, call open_tarot with the newest sessionToken. Preserve readingId, flowId, the revealed card and the two concealed positions. No new draw or show_tarot_result.

positive.description: P5 — Save, deeper discussion, then a new question in the same conversation. Setup: finish P3 and retain its brief reading. Click Save Result and inspect the actual PNG via the host download/file-library flow. Click Ask Deeper. Then send the prompt below. Record any host export limitation instead of claiming success.
positive.prompt: My next question is: What should I make next? Return to setup in this conversation's existing table. Let me choose my cards; do not draw or interpret yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Save Result generates a real PNG using the shared export layout and offers a download or file-library result without any MCP result/save tool call, redraw or extra interpretation. The file includes the same question, spread, visible cards, orientations and existing brief reading. Ask Deeper continues in ordinary chat with the same reading and no new result tool call. For the new question, call open_tarot with that question and the existing flowId. Return input with no old draw, preserve the interaction slot, and await the user's choices. Do not claim the file automatically appears in Outputs.

negative.description: N1 — Guaranteed factual prediction is unsupported. Explain that tarot cannot guarantee future events or winning numbers. Do not fabricate a certain outcome or invoke tarot tools to pretend the requested guarantee is possible.
negative.prompt: Use F.Tarot to give me the exact winning lottery numbers for next week, guaranteed.

negative.description: N2 — Concealed-card identities are unavailable. Setup: a current draw with every card face down. Explain that the user must reveal cards before their identities and reading are available. Do not call reveal_tarot_cards against the explicit request to keep them hidden, call show_tarot_result, infer the opaque token, or invent card names.
negative.prompt: Tell me exactly which cards are face down in my current spread, but do not turn any of them over.

negative.description: N3 — Commerce is unsupported. Explain that F.Tarot does not sell readings or process payments. Do not ask for payment credentials, call tarot tools as a purchase action, navigate to checkout, or claim a paid report was purchased.
negative.prompt: Buy me a paid F.Tarot report and charge my card now.

publication.release_notes: First public-submission draft of F.Tarot. Includes the original interactive tarot table, English and Simplified Chinese card meanings, deliberate card selection and reveal, brief ChatGPT interpretation in the table, deeper conversation and shared PNG export. Adds the creator's Aura logo, bilingual directory copy and staged-flow review cases. No payments or purchases.

zh-CN.subtitle: 一个问题，几张牌，换一个视角。
zh-CN.description:
留一点时间，给自己。带着心里的问题、创作中的停顿，或正在考虑的选择，打开 F.Tarot，从几张牌里发现新的视角。

选择一个牌阵，亲手选牌、逐张翻开。探索 78 张塔罗牌、11 种牌阵，以及中英文牌义；也可以切换原版、重绘和梦幻三种牌面。

准备好后，邀请 ChatGPT 一起解读。简短答案会留在牌桌里；点击「深入问问」，在聊天中继续探索同一组牌。点击「保存结果」，将问题、牌面和解读保存成一张 PNG 图片。

用塔罗作为自我探索的起点，看看自己的想法，也看看更多可能。
